transcription: Main article text only (site header, breadcrumb, sidenav, the 'LAST UPDATED: November 13, 2025' block, share widgets, the 'Have a question?' contact block and footer removed). The impeachment steps keep their 1.–5. numbering; the impeached-presidents list uses • markers as printed. Inline links flattened to their text ('Learn more about the House's role in impeachment.'). Curly quotes kept. Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: how federal impeachment works — grounds (treason, bribery, and 'other high crimes and misdemeanors'), the five-step process (House brings articles, simple-majority adoption impeaches, Senate trial with the chief justice presiding for a president, removal if guilty, possible bar on future office), the numbers (more than 60 proceedings, 21 impeachments, three presidents, one cabinet secretary, one senator; 8 convicted and removed, all federal judges), the impeached presidents with years (Johnson 1868, Clinton 1998, Trump 2019 and 2021, all acquitted) and Nixon's 1974 resignation without impeachment, plus the state/local note. Fits step ordering, quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on counts and dates, and a compare table of House vs Senate roles.
